title: What If All the Continents Merged Into One Again?

scenes.text: What if the continents merged into one? Most mammals might not survive it.
Scientists expect a new supercontinent in about 250 million years, called Pangea Ultima or Pangaea Proxima.
Most land would sit far from any ocean, so inland heat would build.
The Sun will be brighter, and volcanic carbon dioxide could climb above 600 parts per million.
A 2023 University of Bristol study projects widespread heat of 40 to 50 degrees Celsius.
Only about 8 to 16 percent of land would stay livable for mammals.
